children: TriSalus Life Sciences received FDA 510(k) clearance for its TriNav Advance device and expects to begin commercialization.
FDA granted 510(k) clearance for TriNav Advance, expanding the Pressure-Enabled Drug Delivery portfolio.
TriNav Advance provides access to small, distal vessels via a compatible microcatheter, preserving PEDD benefits.
Device can be used in telescoping (with microcatheter) or high-flow (standalone) configurations for varied anatomies.
Company intends to initiate a limited market release of TriNav Advance in the coming weeks.
